entry.title: The Lagacy Time Forgot
entry.summary:
Author: Princesa_de_las_sombras

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 26,375Chapters: 8/?Kudos: 84

Summary: Some encounters only seem like chance. Marinette Dupain-Cheng just hoped a school trip to Gotham would give her a few days away from the troubles chasing her in Paris. Damian Wayne, for his part, never imagined that one simple public appearance could turn his whole world upside down. But when their paths cross, both of them sense something between them they can't explain. Something old.Something impossible.Something that seems to have been waiting for them long before they were born. While Marinette tries to figure out what that strange connection means, and Damian struggles to understand why a stranger has suddenly become the most important person in his life, forces that stayed hidden for centuries slowly begin to stir. Because some secrets can stay buried for generations. But time never truly forgets.

A mischievous, fifth-dimensional imp quickly appears and gives him a chance to prove his claim. To prevent a disappointing ending, he must change the plot as he sees fit. What would a genius detective, Robin, do in the MLB Universe, to cause Chaos of course! ​He wakes up in a world where he is dead, but Alfred is his living ally. To prevent the Love Square, he decides to aggressively befriend Marinette Dupain-Cheng the only way a Wayne knows how: by replacing her friends with competent ones and burying her under a mountain of gifts. Summary: “The whole world will only know what Ladybug tells them. Her words will be the truth.” To the Parisian public, Ladybug wasn't a savior; she was a tyrant who abused absolute power, covered up for Hawk Moth, and allied herself with Chrysalis before being duly punished by a mysterious mystical Order. Thirty-two years later, a smuggling ring in the Gotham docks ends with a vandalized and smashed statue, from which a confused Parisian teenager emerges. Bruce knows that the young woman in his infirmary is classified as a highly dangerous threat, but when Tim discovers classified files and a school photograph reveals the face of a young Talia al Ghul, things start to get complicated. With Marinette Dupain-Cheng seemingly without memory and unsure of who to trust, Bruce will have to discover whether he's protecting a victim or harboring the monster described in the official files. Is Marinette the mastermind who orchestrated the fall of France, or simply the bug caught in something much bigger?
